WITH scoped AS (
SELECT f.*,o.side AS order_side,o.action AS order_action,o.market_ticker AS order_market,
o.raw_order_json::jsonb AS raw_order,o.strategy
FROM fills f JOIN live_orders o ON o.kalshi_order_id=f.kalshi_order_id
AND o.id=(SELECT min(x.id) FROM live_orders x WHERE x.kalshi_order_id=f.kalshi_order_id)
WHERE o.strategy ILIKE '%mmsell%'
)
SELECT side,action,order_side,order_action,raw_fill_json::jsonb->>'side' AS raw_side,
raw_fill_json::jsonb->>'action' AS raw_action,
raw_order->>'side' AS raw_order_side,raw_order->>'action' AS raw_order_action,
raw_order->>'order_action' AS raw_order_action_v1,
count(*) AS fills,
count(*) FILTER(WHERE order_market=market_ticker) AS market_match,
count(*) FILTER(WHERE raw_fill_json::jsonb->>'order_id'=kalshi_order_id) AS raw_order_id_match,
count(*) FILTER(WHERE coalesce(raw_fill_json::jsonb->>'ticker',raw_fill_json::jsonb->>'market_ticker')=market_ticker) AS raw_ticker_match,
count(*) FILTER(WHERE raw_fill_json::jsonb ? 'fee_cost') AS explicit_fee
FROM scoped GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8,9 ORDER BY fills DESC
